title: Define the production read-only provider contract
objective: Repair ReadOnlyMailProvider so Phase 1 adapters share a minimal provider-neutral read boundary. The contract must be abstract, expose only paginated message-reference listing and single-message retrieval, and must not introduce mailbox mutation methods. Do not change the test.
acceptance_criteria: the provider contract is abstract and cannot be instantiated directly
implementations provide list_message_refs with an optional page token
implementations provide get_message by provider message identifier
the base contract introduces no send, delete, label, archive, or trash operations
the fixed acceptance test passes without modification
